name: mgr-control-center
description: ChatGPT-facing control surface for the MGR API/MCP edge, backed by MGR Legacy and Creation OS.

interface.longDescription: Use MGR's authenticated remote MCP edge from ChatGPT to discover tools, read trusted business state, dispatch governed actions through MGR Legacy, and route creation work through Creation OS.
defaultPrompt: Show me what MGR tools are available and what each one does.
Use MGR to pull the current trusted business summary.
Help me complete this task through MGR and show me the resulting receipt or evidence.
